_readme: Hand-tuning overlay for the v3 bot (never touched by training; hot-reloaded by mtime). global.aggression/defense multiply Harmful/Helpful candidate scores; energy_thrift subtracts per energy pip spent; difficulty_tiers are softmax temperatures (higher = sloppier play). Per-character: ability_offsets add to a skill's score, ability_multipliers scale it, banned_abilities are never cast. Ability names are display names, e.g. "Rasengan".
